extraction.Name: Christopher Anderson
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded June 24, 1918, the records do not show by whom
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to L. J. Dunn for $11,000; mortgaged to Scandia Life Insurance Company of Chicago for $2500; Anderson and wife conveyed the land by deed to G. N. Seemann for $11,000
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612788 issued; Northeast quarter section 36, township 97, north of range 73; receipt for patent signed by allottee in February 1918; mortgaged July 2, 1918 to L. J. Dunn for $11,000; on December 11, 1924 Anderson and wife conveyed land by deed to G. N. Seemann for $11,000; also mortgaged to Scandia Life Insurance Company of Chicago for $2500. Document also contains a second allottee entry: Hubert McCloskey (Deceased), Allotment No. 4092, Southwest quarter section 10, township 99, north of range 78; Fee patent No. 612724 issued December 29, 1917; receipt for patent signed by allottee February 12, 1918; patent recorded March 9, 1918 by Volz Abstract Company; on February 28, 1918, Hubert McCloskey and Clara McCloskey mortgaged the land to Peters Trust Company for $2500 due March 1, 1923; on March 31, 1923 the sheriff sold the land for $2989.43 at a foreclosure sale and on April 8, 1924 sheriff's certificate of foreclosure was executed in favor of Peters Trust Company.
